title: I, Robot? Exploring Ultra-Personalized AI-Powered AAC; an Autoethnographic Account
reasoning: The paper focuses on the socio-technical implications of personalizing AAC devices using LLMs, specifically examining agency, identity, and privacy. While it mentions the surfacing of a user's religious background as an example of a privacy breach (contextual integrity violation), it does not evaluate religious representation or moral/ethical reasoning as a core research component.
